title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP SD Consultant Location: Vadodara, Gujarat (On-Site) Job Type: Full Time / Onsite Experience: 1 - 3 Years Shift: General Shift Department: Business Applications 
 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for an SAP SD Consultant with 1-3 years of experience to support SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) processes, configuration, testing, production support, and business requirements. The candidate should have a good understanding of the Order-to-Cash (OTC) cycle and be comfortable working with business users and cross-functional teams. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Support and maintain SAP SD business processes, primarily Order-to-Cash (OTC).
 • Analyze business requirements and provide functional solutions in SAP SD.
 • Perform configuration in areas such as sales orders, deliveries, billing, pricing, copy control, output determination, and basic account determination.
 • Support customer, material, pricing, shipping, and sales-related master data processes.
 • Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP/development teams for enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and workflows.
 • Execute unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
 • Investigate and resolve production issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with relevant technical and functional teams.
 • Support interfaces and integrations between SAP SD and other modules such as MM, FI, and WM/EWM.
 • Prepare and maintain functional documentation, test scripts, process documents, and knowledge-transfer materials.
 • Participate in SAP implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support activities as required. 
 Must-Have Skills: 
 • 1-3 years of hands-on experience in SAP SD.
 • Good understanding of the SAP SD Order-to-Cash (OTC) process.
 • Working knowledge of sales orders, deliveries, billing, pricing, and output determination.
 • Basic understanding of SD integration with MM and FI.
 • Experience in requirement analysis, functional testing, issue resolution, and documentation.
 • Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP functional solutions.
 • Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional and technical teams. 
 Good-to-Have Skills: 
 • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA SD.
 • Knowledge of Stock Transport Orders (STO), intercompany/interplant processes, and shipping processes.
 • Exposure to EDI, IDocs, interfaces, forms, and output management.
 • Basic understanding of SAP LE/WM/EWM integration.
 • Experience with SAP Fiori and S/4HANA business processes.
 • SAP SD certification or relevant SAP training. 
 Job Requirements: 
 • Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
 • 1-3 years of relevant SAP SD consulting/support experience.
 • Willingness to work from the Vadodara office on an on-site basis.
 • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
 • Good written and verbal communication skills.
 • Ability to learn new SAP processes and technologies and adapt to changing business requirements.

Key Skills: SAP SD,EDI IDOCS,ALE IDOC,Order to Cash,Integration,Consignment,STO,Consulting

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP MM Consultant Location: Vadodara, Gujarat (On-Site) Job Type: Full Time / Onsite Experience: 1 - 3 Years Shift: General Shift Department: Business Applications 
 Job Summary: We are looking for a motivated SAP MM Consultant with 1 - 3 years of experience to join our SAP team. The candidate will be responsible for supporting and implementing SAP Materials Management (MM) processes, assisting business users, resolving functional issues, and contributing to SAP implementation and support activities. This position is suitable for candidates who have hands-on exposure to SAP MM configuration and procurement/inventory management processes and are looking to build their career in SAP consulting. 
 Key Responsibilities: Provide functional support for SAP MM related business processes like Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and inventory management. Contribute to analyze the business requirements, troubleshoot issues and identify the solution. Prepare functional design and functional specifications documents. Assist in configuration of SAP MM. Coordinate with ABAP developers for enhancements and bug fixes. Perform testing and record test results. Provide training/support to business users. Coordinate with cross-functional teams such as FI, SD, PP, WM/EWM, and technical teams. 
 Must-Have Skills: 1-3 years of relevant hands-on experience in SAP MM. Exposure to S/4HANA. Good understanding of SAP MM functional processes like Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and inventory management. Basic knowledge of SAP MM configuration. Basic understanding of integration between MM and FI/CO, SD, and PP. Hands-on experience of working on SAP MM master data, PR, PO, GR and invoice verification. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and business teams. 
 Good-to-Have Skills: Knowledge of SAP Fiori applications. Experience with support tickets and incident management. Exposure to SAP implementation or rollout projects. Knowledge of GST/tax-related procurement processes is an advantage. Basic understanding of ABAP debugging and functional specifications is a plus. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Good documentation and presentation skills.

Key Skills: SAP HANA,SAP MM,Inventory Management,P2P Cycle,Master Data,Material Management,Consulting,SAP

title: Sap Pp Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP PP Consultant Location: Vadodara, Gujarat (On-Site) Job Type: Full Time / Onsite Experience: 1 - 3 Years Shift: General Shift Department: Business Apps 
 Job Summary: 
 We are looking for a motivated SAP PP Consultant with 1-3 years of hands-on experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will support the implementation, configuration, and maintenance of SAP Production Planning modules, working closely with cross-functional teams to optimize manufacturing and production processes. 
 Key Responsibilities: Configure and support SAP PP module functionalities including Master Data (BOM, Work Center, Routings, Production Version), Demand Management, MRP, and Production Orders Assist in gathering business requirements and translating them into SAP PP configurations Participate in end-to-end Implementation/Rollout Project, testing, and support activities Coordinate with cross-functional teams (SAP MM, SD, QM, FICO) for integrated business processes Prepare functional specifications for enhancements, reports, and interfaces and work with ABAP team Provide day-to-day support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for SAP PP users Support system testing (unit testing, integration testing, UAT) Document configurations, processes, and standard operating procedures Assist in end-user training and creating training materials 
 Must-Have Skills: 1-3 years of experience in SAP PP module implementation/rollout/support Strong understanding of Production Planning processes along with Tables (Discrete, Repetitive, or Process Manufacturing) Hands-on experience with BOM, Routing, Work Center, MRP, Capacity Planning, and Production Order execution Basic understanding of integration points with MM, SD, QM and FICO modules Good analytical and problem-solving skills Strong communication skills 
 Good-to-Have Skills: Exposure to SAP S/4HANA PP Knowledge of Variant Configuration Familiarity with Advanced Planning tools (SAP APO/IBP) Basic ABAP debugging skills Experience with PP-QM or PP-PI integration Prior experience in a manufacturing/production industry domain Job Requirements: Bachelors degree in engineering or related field SAP PP certification (preferred but not mandatory) Willingness to work in a client-facing/support role Ability to work in rotational shifts Willingness to travel/relocate as per project requirements

Key Skills: Bom,SAP HANA,SAP Production Planning,MRP,Material Requirement Planning,Consulting,Requirements,Production planning
